products.title: Big Green Egg x YETI Hopper® M30 Tote Soft Cooler
products.body_html:
The YETI Hopper M30 Cooler is legendary for its ability to haul ice and cold drinks into the wild. For Big Green Egg cooks, it's also perfect for resting a brisket, a pork butt, or any protein. The Hopper lets juices settle, holds heat for hours, and lives up the to the YETI promise of quality and durability.

 

MagShield Access 

Powerful magnets create an ultra leak-resistant seal that stays open when you need it and snaps closed with a gentle push.  

Built for the Long Haul  

The Hopper® M30’s DryHide™ shell uses high-density fabric engineered to resist punctures, UV exposure, and hard use around the firepit, tailgate, or campsite.  

ColdCell™ Insulation  

Closed-cell foam insulation helps maintain steady temperatures — keeping briskets warm for hours or drinks ice cold for the day ahead.  

Leakproof Interior  

Radio frequency welded construction eliminates stitched seams for a fully leakproof liner that’s easy to clean after use.    

Reinforced Carry Points  

Double-stitched handles and reinforced pickup points give the Hopper® M30 the strength to haul heavy loads with confidence.  

 

Tips for Using Your Cooler as a Resting Bag:  

Liner protection: Double wrap your meat tightly in butcher paper or foil, then place in a leak-proof container or bag before placing it in the cooler to protect the M30's interior liner from the hot meat and grease that can cause damage.  

Hold temperatures steady: Use towels to fill any empty space or air pockets to help stabilize and hold temperatures. 

Food safety: Ensure the internal temperature of your protein stays above 140°F (60°C) for food safety.  

Residual Smell: Smoke and grease can leave a lingering scent and oil residue in soft cooler liners. Using a "sacrificial" towel or an open plastic bag inside the towels can help catch leaks and odors.  

Bark Integrity: While coolers are great for tenderness, the trapped steam can sometimes soften the brisket's "bark." If you prefer a crunchier exterior, consider resting it on the counter until it hits 170-180°F (76-82°C) before moving it to the cooler 

Orientation Matters: Lay the cooler on its side so the brisket rests flat. This helps keep the meat supported and juices evenly distributed during the rest. 

 

WARNING: Do not leave your soft cooler open in the presence of animals. Entrapment and suffocation can occur.  

WARNING: Hopper® Soft Coolers are not compatible with dry ice. Use of dry ice will cause airtight vessel to explode.  

WARNING: This product contains magnets. Placing near a pacemaker may cause interference. 

WARNING: Do not place meat in the cooler without first putting it in a leak-proof container or bag. Wrapping it in butcher paper, foil, or towels alone can put the liner in direct contact with hot, greasy, or moist foods. This contact can severely damage the product and should be avoided.

products.title: New Mexico 9th Annual EggFest
products.body_html:
Join us for one of Clovis's favorite traditions — a backyard cook-off where local pitmasters compete for glory (and a killer engraved cutting board). Each year, 150–200 hungry attendees turn out to sample dishes from a lineup of 4–9 dedicated cooks, many of whom have been slinging plates since Year 1 — some have competed in all 8 events to date.

How it works:
Cooks bring their A-game (and their own ingredients and utensils) to prepare their signature dishes. Attendees buy tickets to sample everything on offer and cast their vote for the best bite. Top 3 finishers take home engraved cutting board trophies — pure bragging rights on the line.

Burns has you covered:
Eggs, ConvEGGtor plates, and charcoal/starters are all provided by Burns, so cooks can focus on the food.

It's for a great cause:
Every dollar raised is matched by Burns and donated to Angel Arms, a local charity that helps send airmen stationed at the local USAF base home for the holidays when they can't afford the trip themselves.
Come hungry, bring your appetite for competition, and help send a few airmen home this season.

products.title: 10th Annual Martinsville EGGfest
products.body_html:
Join us at the 10th annual Martinsville Ace Eggfest! Come for the food and stay for the Music!

Get ready for the Hoosier Eggheads to fire up the Eggs and enjoy some tasty eats at the 10th Annual Martinsville Ace Eggfest. This in-person event is all about fun, food, and giving back to the community. Don't miss this awesome day of smoky goodness!

Who are the Hoosier Eggheads? They are Big Green Egg enthusiasts with heart. They donate their time and expertise on the Egg. We donate the food, and when you donate for a meal...our collective reason for gathering is complete by providing 100% of your meal donation directly to our single cause!

Since 2017, because of all the meals you have bought, we have raised over $80,000 for Stability First!

products.title: Chef Lance Lewis + Big Green Egg Academy
products.body_html:
Chef Lance Lewis is a master of grilling and smoking, widely recognized for his expertise in wild game cooking and sustainable culinary practices. A passionate advocate for responsible hunting and conservation, he has been featured in leading publications like Hook & Barrel and Forbes for his innovative approach to live-fire cooking.

With an engaging and hands-on teaching style, Chef Lance makes the art of grilling accessible to everyone—from weekend warriors to seasoned pitmasters. Whether perfecting the smoke on a brisket, grilling back yard burgers, or crafting bold flavors over an open flame, his sought-after techniques elevate every meal.

Through the Big Green Egg Academy, Chef Lance shares his knowledge, inspiring others to embrace the beauty of grilling, sustainability, and tradition. Join him in redefining outdoor cooking—one expertly prepared dish at a time.

products.title: 12th Annual Central Florida Fall Eggfest
products.body_html:
The Central Florida Fall EggFest  is an annual event dedicated to the Big Green Egg grill and Egg enthusiasts known as Eggheads. Whether you own an Egg or just want to sample some unique new tastes from slow-cooked BBQ to baked goods, then the EggFest is for you!

The event is hosted at the beautiful Wekiva Island (“Egg Central”) rain or shine!

Proceeds from the festival benefit Wekiva Wilderness Trust to support their continuous efforts to keep our community clean.

products.title: Cast Iron Grid for L
products.body_html:
The grill pattern is the chef's signature. With the Cast Iron Grid, you can create it yourself on butterflies, cuts of meat, and vegetables. This cast iron grill gives perfectly browned meat, which better preserves the meat juices. Have you signed your dish? Then it's time to serve.

If you like the sizzle and bubble, place your burgers, short ribs, chops, and tuna on the Cast Iron Grid. Eggplants, zucchinis, asparagus, and peppers also get the characteristic grilling pattern. The Cast Iron Grid heats up quickly and can handle very high temperatures.

products.title: Quick Light™ Kit Medium
products.body_html:
Our Quick Light™ charcoal grate and starter tool give you a better way to start the fire. Whether you're a seasoned grill master or new to cooking on the Egg, the Quick Light Kit gives you faster, more reliable ignition, less ash buildup, cleaner hands, and more even-burning coals. Light your charcoal from below, every time you start your Egg.

Ready to Cook Sooner: Efficient ignition from the bottom of the Egg helps you reach cooking temperature more quickly.

Cleaner hands: No need to bury a fire starter or rearrange charcoal by hand. Simply dump charcoal into your Egg’s firebox and light it from below.

More Even Heat: The honeycomb grate improves airflow to help minimize hot spots and maintain consistent cooking temperatures. 

Reduces Ash Buildup: Larger grate openings allow ash to fall through for easier cleanup.

Built to Last: Heavy-duty 430 stainless steel can stand up to decades of high-heat cooking.

Compatible with M Eggs.

(Quick Light Tool does not work with cast iron charcoal grate.)

products.title: Half Moon convEGGtor for XL
products.body_html:
Incredibly versatile is an understatement when it comes to the Half convEGGtor Stone. Use it together with the 1-piece convEGGtor basket as an intermediate layer when you want to cook in two zones, one for direct heat and one for indirect heat. Or as a full convection shield when two are placed against each other.

Designed to be a "burn-free zone stone" when the two are combined, maximizing cooking surface. With a convEGGtor, the smaller diameter means food lying around the edges can burn. So it's perfect for cooking large volumes at lower temperatures, like chicken wings. When using one half for two-zone cooking, you have the other half left where you can cook without worrying about burning. The Half convEGGtor Stone is made of Big Green Egg ceramic.

Note: When using the 5-piece EGGspander Kit, only 1 Half convEGGtor Stone fits the middle level due to its size.

products.title: Natural Lump Hardwood Charcoal
products.body_html:
Experience authentic Brazilian Steakhouse Flavor!

Whether you are grilling churrasco in the gaucho tradition, or cooking a more delicate cut of fish or pork, you’ll enjoy the mild, oaky flavor of our restaurant quality Brazilian Hardwood Lump Charcoal. This subtle flavor profile pairs well with smoking chips and chunks for a variety of flavor profiles.

Lights Quickly, Burns Hotter and Longer

Because it lights quickly and burns hotter and longer than most other woods, eucalyptus wood is the preferred fuel for the most famous Brazilian steakhouses. Big Green Egg Lump Charcoal reaches cooking temperature in just minutes, and is more fuel efficient than charcoal briquettes or pellets.

It’s only Natural

Our lump charcoal contains no fillers, nitrates, chemicals, or petroleum products. Our premium lump charcoal produces less ash than briquettes, so there is minimal waste and clean up … delivering more value and performance in every bag!

Big Green Egg Brazilian Hardwood Charcoal is produced using sustainable eucalyptus wood, and the process includes soil and water preservation efforts, with no deforestation.

Adds a mild, oaky flavor to foods, and works well with smoking chips and chunks for a variety of flavor profiles.

products.title: Natural Lump Charcoal Canadian Maple
products.body_html:
Big Green Egg natural lump charcoal is an ultra-premium, natural product made only from select hardwoods. Unlike some other popular charcoals, pellets, or briquettes, this 100% natural product contains no fillers, nitrates, chemicals, coal, limestone, treated wood, or petroleum products of any kind. Demand the best for you Big Green Egg – and for The Ultimate Cooking Experience.

**Not available in all markets**

Enjoy the Mild Flavor of Canadian Maple

The flavor profile of our Natural Canadian Maple charcoal is the mildest of all Big Green Egg charcoal varieties. It is ideal for seafood, vegetables, pork, poultry, or any time you want the natural flavor of your food to shine through.

Sourced only from sustainable hardwood forests in Canada, this premium maple charcoal is easy to light and clean burning, imparting a subtle, sweet flavor to your food.

products.title: Ultra Performance Gasket Replacement Kit
products.body_html:
After long and intensive use of your Big Green Egg, the felt strip on the upper edge of the ceramic base and the lower edge of the ceramic lid will wear out. Since this strip protects the ceramic and regulates perfect air circulation, it is recommended to replace it in time. And you can easily do that with this Gasket Kit. The roll of felt is self-adhesive and the strip is easy to replace.

Regardless of which Egg model you have, we have a roll of self-adhesive felt for it. The felt can withstand extremely high temperatures and you don't need any glue. Even new do-it-yourselfers can handle this task without problems.

If you prefer a Big Green Egg expert to do it for you, choose the annual maintenance plan. Then we'll replace the felt for you.

products.title: Table Nest
products.body_html:
With the Table Nest, you literally place your Big Green Egg on a stand. It is specially designed to support the EGG and protect the table, kitchen island, or your custom-built outdoor kitchen from the heat released. Another advantage: with the Table Nest, you won't get any burn marks on the table.

The Table Nest's metal stand ensures that hot air can flow freely under the EGG. Want to integrate the Table Nest into your worktop? That's certainly possible too. It's not suitable as a standalone stand, so place it on a solid (and non-flammable) surface. Spilled something? The table stand can be cleaned with a damp cloth.

Table Nests are not suitable as freestanding stands, so place them on a solid (and non-flammable) surface. The metal stand ensures that hot air can flow freely under the EGG. Want to integrate the Table Nest into your worktop? That's certainly possible too. Spilled something? The table stand can be cleaned with a damp cloth.

DO NOT USE A TABLE NEST TO SUPPORT AN EGG UNLESS THE EGG IS HOUSED WITHIN A TABLE, ISLAND OR OTHER SURROUND.
THE LOW-PROFILE TABLE NEST IS NOT DESIGNED OR INTENDED AS A FREE-STANDING SUPPORT for your EGG. Only the Mini and MiniMax have a low-profile Nest designed to be used as a free-standing base.
THE EGG IS DESIGNED TO BE USED IN A METAL NEST OR WITH A METAL TABLE NEST, PROVIDING AN AIR GAP BELOW THE EGG - however you must exercise caution and not place an EGG directly over combustible material such as ground cover or an extremely dry wood surface even if using a Table Nest.
FOR MAXIMUM HEAT PROTECTION, IT IS BEST THAT A GRANITE TILE AND A METAL TABLE NEST BE USED IN COMBINATION, particularly if EGG is routinely used for long cooks or high temperature cooking and is placed over a wood surface.
PERIODICALLY CHECK THE AREA DIRECTLY BELOW THE EGG to ensure that over time there is no deterioration on the surface under the EGG due to heat transfer.

products.body_html:
Nature takes its course. Just look at the Acacia Table. This handmade table consists of solid acacia planks and has naturally shaped grain and unique color variations. Therefore, each table is unique. The Acacia Table transforms your Big Green Egg into a complete outdoor kitchen with enough space for utensils and dishes. Place the EGG in the table on a Table Nest for necessary air circulation.

Everyone enjoys gathering around the Acacia Table thanks to its warm ambiance. As the acacia tree is incomparably the most durable and hardest wood species, it is the perfect place for a Big Green Egg Large or XLarge. And do you want to move your kitchen island? Add on four sturdy wheels so you can roll your setup to the perfect spot—whether that’s in the shade or right where the action is.

products.body_html:

You can use in your EGG for everything from seared steaks and seafood, braised meats and casseroles to gratins, cornbread, biscuits and cobblers.

  • Pre-seasoned with food-safe vegetable oil
  • Big Green Egg logo is molded into the bottom of the skillet
  • High quality casting
  • CARE: Hand wash with a brush and water only; dry immediately and lightly coat with cooking oil after each use. Clean with soap and water before first use. Soap is not recommended after initial cleaning; never wash cast iron in the dishwasher.

products.body_html: These stainless steel BBQ Tongs are perfect for turning grilled foods, sautéing vegetables, serving pastas and tossing salads. The BPA-free silicone-tipped tongs are dishwasher safe and heat resistant up to 500°F/260°C.

products.body_html:
The Multifunctional Ribs and Roasting Rack is perfect for cooking a large roast. The stand is a V-rack: it fits large pieces of meat or (stuffed) poultry that need to be cooked slowly. When you turn the rack over, it's perfect for cooking ribs. The constant airflow around the Ribs and Roasting Rack provides fantastic results. A must-have for all meat lovers.

You can also use the Ribs and Roasting Rack as a resting shelf for even juicier meat. Tip! Combine the rack with the matching Rectangular Drip Pan. This catches the meat juices and gives you a nice base for making a good gravy. The V-rack can hold a roast of about 5 kg.

products.title: rEGGulator Vent Cap
products.body_html:
The new and robust rEGGulator can be adjusted with extreme precision. It is made of durable cast iron, and with the cool silicone grip, you can easily increase or decrease airflow without burning your fingers. Another practical feature: we have already applied a coating that prevents rust formation, allowing you to leave it on the EGG after use.

Big Green Egg was already known for its precise temperature control, but after two years of product development, the highest degree of perfection has now been achieved. The new patented air vent is the successor to the metal top and has an ergonomic design, as well as improvements in usability and durability. If you completely close the air supply, the EGG becomes 100% airtight, causing it to extinguish. If it starts to rain while you're using the EGG, you can give the air vent its own rain protection with the Rain Cap accessory to prevent rain from entering the EGG.

products.body_html: There's always a risk of rain when you're using your EGG. products.title: Egg Frame with stainless grid insert for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
The EGG Frame is the base unit, delivered with a stainless steel grid shelf, hooks for your tools, and 4 adjustable legs. The table legs and frame are made of powder-coated aluminum and steel. You can also mount caster wheels on the legs. While renovating can be stressful, expanding is just fun.

Features:

  • Includes an EGG Frame, stainless steel grid insert, and Tool Hooks
  • 4 adjustable feet included, Caster Kit can also be mounted on the legs
  • The lower shelf frame and cross beams are made of steel for extra strength
  • Upper aluminum frame and legs; if the powder-coated surface is scratched, the frame remains rust-free

products.title: Dome
products.body_html: This replacement dome fits your EGG model, ensuring your Big Green Egg maintains its optimal cooking performance. Crafted with durable materials, it's an essential component for preserving heat and flavor in your outdoor cooking adventures.

products.title: Disposable Aluminum Trays
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg Disposable Drip Pans are custom-designed to work perfectly with a convEGGtor. These pans provide an easy and convenient cleanup when cooking indirect.  
 
  • Custom-designed to work with the convEGGtor
  • Protects the convEGGtor for easy clean up
  • Convenient and disposable aluminum foil for easy clean up
  • 5 per pack

products.title: Corner Modular Nest
products.body_html:
The Corner Modular Nest is a 90-degree angle solution for your outdoor kitchen egg setup.

  • Dimensions: Consult product manual for specific measurements
  • Material: Powder-coated aluminum
  • Includes: 5 levelers

Precision-engineered from powder-coated aluminum, this addition to the Modular Nest System ensures stability and durability in any environment. Five included levelers guarantee a perfectly balanced cooking surface, while the option to add casters offers effortless mobility. By joining this cornerstone to your existing modules, you're not just expanding your setup—you're unlocking new possibilities for your culinary creativity.

products.title: Replacement Acacia Wood Handle
products.body_html: This replacement handle is designed specifically for the 2XL Big Green Egg model. Easily transform your grill with this durable and easy-to-install handle, ensuring a secure grip and enhanced safety during use.

products.title: Cast Iron Half Grid
products.body_html: The Cast Iron Half Grid only covers half the grill, Allowing plenty of space for other cooking options. Heats up quickly and can handle very high temperatures.
